title: Saudi Arabian Date Pudding
description: A rich and creamy dessert inspired by Saudi Arabian cuisine, featuring velvety date pudding and a hint of zesty flavor.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the cornstarch and a splash of coconut milk until smooth.
In a medium saucepan, combine the remaining coconut milk, sugar, and cornstarch mixture.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the pudding thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in the date puree and arabian coffee (if using).
Let cool to room temperature, then refrigerate until chilled.
Serve the date pudding in individual cups or ramekins, garnished with a sprinkle of zesty orange zest.
